### Tier 1 — realistic sizing — .NET field

Outputs that fit the size of a real page, partial or fragment, and stay clear of the 85,000-byte Large Object Heap threshold once materialised as UTF-16. **These are the primary results.**

| Workload | Golden | Heddle | Next .NET engine | Margin |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| trivial-substitution | 338 B | 164.6 ns | Handlebars.Net 2.1.6 — 517.3 ns | **3.14×** |
| fortunes-encoded | 1,156 B | 938.7 ns | Handlebars.Net 2.1.6 — 2.4 μs | **2.56×** |
| fragment-heavy | 4,730 B | 3.907 μs | Fluid.Core 2.31.0 — 14.29 μs | **3.66×** |
| mixed-page | 9,712 B | 3.591 μs | Handlebars.Net 2.1.6 — 9.854 μs | **2.74×** |
| conditional-heavy | 15,549 B | 19.78 μs | Handlebars.Net 2.1.6 — 46.72 μs | **2.36×** |

### Tier 2 — edge-case sizing — .NET field

Outputs that exceed the 85,000-byte Large Object Heap threshold as UTF-16, so every .NET render allocates on the LOH and drives a full Gen2 collection — a cost structural to the runtime and absent in the other five ecosystems. These are stress tests, not page renders; read them with that caveat attached.

| Workload | Golden | Heddle | Next .NET engine | Margin |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| composed-page | 34,847 B | 30.52 μs | Fluid.Core 2.31.0 — 41.17 μs | **1.35×** |
| large-loop | 192,780 B | 379.3 μs | Handlebars.Net 2.1.6 — 651.3 μs | **1.72×** |
| encoded-loop | 831,685 B | 1.882 ms | Handlebars.Net 2.1.6 — 1.46 ms | **0.78× — Heddle loses** |
